CustomField.description: Calculates the exact date when a standard Task should be generated by the StandardTaskGenerationBatch. The formula subtracts the Creation_Offset__c from the related Opportunity's Drive_Date__c. It returns blank if either of those fields is null.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Related_Opportunity__r.Drive_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Creation_Offset__c)) ), Related_Opportunity__r.Drive_Date__c - Creation_Offset__c, NULL )
CustomField.label: Calculated Creation Date
